title: Global Market: Japan stocks rise ahead of Nvidia earnings, US inflation data
description: Japanese shares edged higher on Wednesday as investors awaited Nvidias quarterly earnings and key US inflation data for clues on the outlook for artificial intelligence spending and Federal Reserve policy. The Nikkei 225 rose 0.56%, while the broader Topix gained 0.61%. SoftBank Group led gains among major stocks, while investors also monitored the US PCE inflation data for signals on the Feds next rate move.
